messages:
maria: Quick sync  I'm refreshing the HelloApp quickstart to make token auth explicit across examples and to add small migration guidance. Plan: prefer REDWOOD_KEY in snippets (keep fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY), update .env.sample, add Console token callout, and include tiny language snippets (JS + Python + iOS). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/quickstart/pull/499 (WIP)

devon: happy to update JS/TS snippets in the SDK repo. prefer named import `RedwoodClient` and async/await pattern. will also update the curl examples to use Authorization: Bearer header.

renata: i'll add a Python snippet for the tutorials since some users ask for it: small requests library example using os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY', os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')). keeping it single-request minimal. also adding an iOS/Swift example stub for mobile onboarding (very small).

lila: i'll update the quickstart .env.sample and README. found one outdated link to /docs/old-helloapp that breaks anchors on the new site  will swap to /docs/quickstart/helloapp and add a screenshot of Console token creation (1200px width, blurred token).

sachin: add migration blurb: "Existing setups using REDWOOD_API_KEY will continue to work; REDWOOD_KEY is the recommended name going forward." Also security note: blur token values in screenshots and recommend minimal scopes and rotation guidance for orgs.

devon: proposed JS snippet:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/ft-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(res.text);
```

renata: Python snippet idea:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY') or os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/ft-1', prompt='Hello world')
print(resp.text)
```

lila: pushed .env.sample, README updates, and the blurred screenshot. kept image <200kb. fixed the broken anchor.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-499--docs.redwood.ai (quickstart) and https://deploy-preview-223--sdk.redwood.ai (snippets) :white_check_mark:

devon: added a tiny jest mock test asserting Authorization header set when env var present. also changed snippets to named import.

sachin: quick wording nit: add one straightforward sentence for non-developers explaining where Console > API tokens lives. then LGTM.

maria: added CHANGELOG note under docs: "quickstart: prefer REDWOOD_KEY in examples; preserve REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback; add language snippets (py, swift)." Opening follow-up to add CLI token creation commands.

lila: assigned reviewers @devon @sachin @renata. will merge once SDK and quickstart previews are green.

devon: approved SDK snippet PR; will merge after quickstart preview check.

docs-bot: visual diff checks passed for quickstart.

maria: merged both PRs. follow-ups: add plain-English Console token helper for non-devs and rotation/KMS blurb for enterprise. closing this sync  thanks all :tada:
